title: Bananas Are Berries, Strawberries Are Not?!
caption:
Your banana is a berry and your strawberry is a lie.
A cartoon guy sits down to a fruit bowl, then a botanical chart flips everything he knows.
Botanically, a banana is a true berry that grows from a single ovary, while a strawberry is an aggregate accessory fruit, not a berry at all.
Which fruit shocked you more, the banana or the strawberry?
Share this with a friend who swears strawberries are berries.
